purpose: Teach: パフォーマンス/エントリー/オーナー/ミニ/マイル/ソニー/純粋/要件

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 今日のパフォーマンス、正直マジで良かったよ。エントリーした時はどうなるかと思ったけど。
lines.en: Your performance today was honestly really great. When you entered, I wasn't sure how it'd go.
lines.style: Warm casual praise from an older university student to a younger teammate.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: いやー、純粋に楽しかったっす。チームのオーナーが見に来てたって聞いて、緊張したけど。
lines.en: Yeah, I purely just had fun out there. I heard the team owner came to watch, so I was nervous though.
lines.style: Casual teen speech with ssu ending, showing humility and excitement.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: オーナー来てたの?マジか。じゃあ来月のミニ大会の出場要件、絶対クリアできるっしょ。
lines.en: The owner came? No way. Then you'll definitely clear the entry requirements for next month's mini tournament.
lines.style: Surprised, encouraging tone, casual university student speech.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 要件って、確かタイムが基準内じゃないとダメなんすよね。今日ので要件ギリ届いたかな…
lines.en: The requirements — you have to be within the time standard, right? I think I just barely made the requirements today.
lines.style: Uncertain, thinking out loud, casual teenage tone with ssu.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 届いてたよ、計ってた。あと遠征のマイル、今シーズンでだいぶ貯まったんじゃない?
lines.en: You made it, I was timing you. Also, your travel miles must have piled up a lot this season, right?
lines.style: Reassuring, then shifting to a lighter follow-up question.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: マイルはヤバいくらい貯まってます。あと、ソニーのカメラ買ったんすよ、自分のフォーム見直すために。
lines.en: My miles are stacked ridiculously high. Also, I bought a Sony camera to review my own form.
lines.style: Enthusiastic teen sharing a recent purchase, casual and proud.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ソニーの?お前マジで意識高いな。その純粋な気持ちが続けば、絶対もっと上行けるよ。
lines.en: A Sony one? Dude, you're seriously dedicated. If that pure mindset continues, you'll definitely go even further.
lines.style: Genuinely impressed older mentor figure, casual and supportive.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。次は全国エントリーが目標なんで、付き合ってもらえると嬉しいっす。
lines.en: Thank you. Entering nationals is my next goal, so I'd be glad if you keep training with me.
lines.style: Sincere, slightly more polite teen tone expressing genuine gratitude.
